stage1.impression: A dark brown box seen down its length, with a pink-red glowing object half hidden behind a lounge chair at the far end, a cool grey lit alcove on the left, and a row of identical walnut stools. At 1:1 the floor is mottled denoiser smear with blobby stool shadows and a hard white strip of light across the threshold. None of the walls, ceiling or furniture faces reads as concrete, fir or steel; it reads as a game interior, not a photograph.

blocking_9: The floor and walls hold real texture at 1:1 (board-formed concrete grain, tie holes, fir checks, steel patina) with no denoiser smear or blotching
The Ember speaker reads at a glance as a red tinted-acrylic cabinet with its horn, unobstructed, seen through a smoked partition that shows as a surface (a reflection or edge), not as pink neon
The right-hand booths and their frosted screens are legible (screen panels glowing softly, leather and fir caps catching light), not a lum-9 black block
The fir beams and the three Moon pendants over the bar are in frame and read; the ceiling is not a flat textureless band
The back-bar's clear acrylic shelves with lit edges and bottles read as the left wall's subject, warm, not an empty cool-grey alcove
No hard white light strip across the floor at the listening-room threshold; light falls off in pools
Signs of life (a glass on the bar, a coat on a stool, a record out) and less obvious repetition of identical stools and chairs
Delivered at full 2400 x 1600 with clean noise

defects.what: Floor is denoiser smear: blotchy, mottled patches and soft-edged blob shadows of the stools, no concrete texture
Hard cool-white strip of light across the floor at the listening-room threshold (p95 160 against 45 around it), reads as a stage spill
Speaker reads as pink/magenta neon (r98 g51 b54), haloed by haze, half hidden behind a lounge chair; horn barely legible
Smoked acrylic partition is invisible: no edge, no reflection, nothing between the bar and the listening room
Right-hand wall block is dead flat black (lum median 8.9, range 6.6): frosted screens above the booths do not glow at all
Booths unreadable (lum median 10.4); leather and fir caps show no form
Ceiling is a flat featureless band (lum range 18); no fir beams, no pendants over the bar visible
Left alcove is an empty cool-grey box (r76 g70 b69) with one lamp; no acrylic shelves, bottles or Fog niche legible; the light cone has a CG-clean gradient
Four identical stools in a row, same model and spacing; rim-lit from the back so the walnut looks like smooth CG wood
Repeated identical black lounge chairs with matching side tables in the listening room
Walls everywhere read as dark brown panelling; nothing reads as board-formed concrete or blackened steel

changes.problem: The floor and walls are denoiser smear with blotchy patches, which reads instantly as a render.

evidence.measured: Crop at 2x shows mottled blobs and soft blob shadows; no concrete grain anywhere

change.to: 1024 / 0.005 (and render the check at scale 0.5, not 0.3)

changes.expected: Floor shows continuous concrete texture and shadows with defined edges; no blotches at 1:1.

changes.problem: The hero speaker is half hidden behind a lounge chair and is a small part of the frame.

evidence.measured: Chair back covers the right third of the cabinet and the horn's lower half

change.to: [4.0, 2.6, 1.2], target [16.6, 3.6, 1.15] (move left so the near chair slides right off the speaker)

changes.expected: The whole cabinet and horn are clear of the chair, framed between the chairs, and the camera now looks level so verticals stay true.

changes.problem: The ceiling, the fir beams and the pendants over the bar are not in frame, so the room reads as a dark box.

change.to: 32 mm (with the level aim from c2)

changes.expected: Two or three beams and the Moon pendants enter the top third; the bar runs the full left side.

changes.problem: The booths' frosted screens and the booths are dead black on the right third.

change.setting: the screens' images emission; table lamps (EARF Moon lamp in each table lamp)

changes.expected: The screens glow softly with their images readable through the frost; pools of warm light on each booth table pick out leather and fir caps.

changes.problem: A hard cool-white strip lies across the floor at the listening room's threshold.

evidence.measured: p95 160.6 against p95 80 in the floor just in front; y-profile peaks at 112 then drops to 47

change.setting: lamps on each Ember speaker (4 x area, W/m2 at the target)
change.to: 20.0, and record-wall spots 18 W -> 30 W to keep the listening room up

changes.expected: The threshold light falls off smoothly; no band brighter than the bar-top pools.

changes.problem: The grade neutralises the 2400 K practicals to grey and pushes the speaker's red to pink.

evidence.measured: alcove r76 g70 b69 (grey); speaker r98 g51 b54 (pink)

changes.expected: Practicals read warm amber, the alcove warm grey, the speaker a deeper red rather than pink.

changes.problem: The back-bar's acrylic shelves, bottles and Fog niche do not read; the left side is an empty lit box.

evidence.measured: one lamp, a flat grey wall, no shelf edges or bottle highlights visible in the crop

change.setting: the shelves' lit edges emission; the niches' frosted backs emission; haze density

changes.expected: Glowing polished shelf edges in lines along the back-bar with bottle highlights; less veiling haze so the far end holds contrast.

changes.problem: Nothing says anyone is here, and the identical stools in a row read as copies.

evidence.measured: four identical stools at equal spacing and angle; empty bar top

change.from: glasses, menus, candles placed off the visible bar
change.to: two rocks glasses and a folded menu on the bar top in the near pool, a coat over the second stool, stools turned 5 to 15 degrees each, a record out of its sleeve on a listening-room side table

changes.expected: Signs of life in the foreground; the stool row breaks its repetition.

out_of_scope.request: Make the walls read unmistakably as board-formed concrete (visible board grain, tie holes) rather than dark brown panelling
out_of_scope.why: The material's tone and sheen may change, but if the wall geometry and texture are not board-formed concrete in the model, that is a room-design or asset fix, not a setting

out_of_scope.request: Vary the listening-room lounge chairs and bar stools (different models or wear)
out_of_scope.why: The stools and listening room are fixed by the card

out_of_scope.request: Give the smoked acrylic partition a visible frame or reveal
out_of_scope.why: The partition's design is fixed; only lighting (a reflection of a pendant) can reveal it
